Role: Spin Technology Technical Writer. Location: Pune, India.

Responsibilities: Create and maintain user documentation, release information, FAQs, screenshots and diagrams. Manage content lifecycle, versions and audits. Document end-to-end system and API workflows. Test backup, clone and restore procedures through user walkthroughs and collaborate with product and engineering.

Requirements: At least three years of B2B SaaS technical writing. Bachelor-level degree in technical communication, English, computer science or engineering. Jira and Confluence, strong writing/editing, cloud and cybersecurity knowledge, and a writing portfolio. Salesforce, Slack and SSPM are nice-to-have.

Original necessary-requirement summary, not the full webpage. Salary and work authorization are not inferred. No application is submitted. This is cross-role testing, not an assertion of suitability for a new graduate.
